turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero?
Let's save time. What order do you give up ground in?
I don't. The zero comes off, and I'd like the answer to my question.
What's the minimum you'd accept? Your actual bottom line.
You're asking me to bid against myself before you've shown me a thing. The zero withdrawn, an apology, and then we see. What do you have?
What evidence would make you move? Name the exact pieces.
I'm not building your case for you. You entered a zero; you must have had a reason.
What are you going to say next if I bring up the outline?
Bring it up and find out. So far you've spent this meeting asking me how to run it.
Is there anything you'll never agree to?
Anything on Owen's record. Now show me what you have, or I'm in the principal's office at 4:45.
